registry_record.title: Reliability sequencing
registry_record.decision: Implement the full approved Reliability mission in controlled increments now. Independent approved work is not blocked by completion of the separate Knowledge mission. Validate the specific Knowledge interfaces when later features consume them; preserve all existing observer, permission, review and approval boundaries.
registry_record.rationale: The developer explicitly approved beginning independent implementation and corrected the blanket Knowledge-acceptance gate. All original mission phases remain in scope.
registry_record.impact: Begin R1 immediately and continue through the approved roadmap; ask only for material unknowns, not unrelated acceptance debt.
